$comment: Client-defined hooks for the bro plugin. SessionStart rehydrates beads context (ready work + active drill frame) so a fresh session or post-compaction agent resumes from bd state, not transcript. When the client exports a plugin-root var the call routes through hooks/run.sh (PATH → dist → npx resolution, fail-open); otherwise `command -v` guards make every hook a silent no-op without bd/bro.

hooks.command: P="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${DEVIN_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}/.."; if [ -f "$P/hooks/run.sh" ]; then "$P/hooks/run.sh" session-start; else command -v bd >/dev/null 2>&1 && { bd ready 2>/dev/null | head -20; command -v bro >/dev/null 2>&1 && bro drill current; }; fi; exit 0
P="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${DEVIN_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}/.."; if [ -f "$P/hooks/run.sh" ]; then "$P/hooks/run.sh" pre-compact; else command -v bro >/dev/null 2>&1 && bro drill current; fi; exit 0
